items.title: Zcash holders to vote on pulling 50,000 ZEC, worth $50 million, from grants treasury
items.description: The proposal would remove more than half of Zcash Community Grants' ZEC holdings from circulation and redirect its future block rewards into a new development and legal-defense fund.

items.title: Bitcoin Core reveals bug that made thousands of nodes trust any stranger on Tor
items.description: The flaw was fixed in October 2025 and kept quiet until Tuesday. It came out alongside a high-severity bug that could stop a miner from producing blocks until someone restarted it.

items.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
items.description: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.

items.title: Nvidia perps crash 7% as CEO Jensen Huang reportedly faces the axe
items.description: Nvidia perps are down 7% on Hyperliquid as traders react to reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be removed. Bitcoin continues to trade in a familiar price range.

items.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
items.description: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

items.title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
items.description: After initial issuer pushback, the blockchain venue is set to start trading on Nov. 23 and said will list over 70 assets, including Strategy’s common and preferred shares and 59 of Direxion's ETFs.

items.title: Meet Spiko, the largest tokenized fund in the world you’ve probably never heard about
items.description: The firm’s flagship Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (SAFO) held $2.39 billion in assets under management as of late last month.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin remains under pressure as CoreWeave, Nvidia lead AI rebound
items.description: The DRAM ETF jumps 8% and semiconductor stocks gain more than 4%, while bitcoin continues to test its 200-day moving average.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: South Korea to permit crypto withdrawal freezes during hacking threats
items.description: The move follows recent security incidents involving South Korean crypto exchanges, including GOPAX’s precautionary suspension of services and a $70,000 hot-wallet breach at Prabang.

items.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
items.description: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

items.title: MSCI confirms Strategy’s removal from indexes at end of November
items.description: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi are marked for deletion in MSCI’s final list, with changes taking effect after the Nov. 30 close.

items.title: Suiet wallet to shut down in latest exit from Sui ecosystem
items.description: The self-custodial wallet will keep its API services running through Nov. 14. Sui’s DeFi total value locked has fallen more than 22% over the past month.

items.title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after affairs: WSJ
items.description: The report about Huang’s possible departure came after the New York Times reported that he had a second extramarital affair.

items.title: Uncalled US House races could send more crypto allies to Congress
items.description: The remaining races feature pro-crypto candidates and others without a stated position, giving advocacy groups what they see as “an opportunity” for outreach.

items.title: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg
items.description: The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations.

items.title: Nvidia board meeting to decide CEO Jensen Huang’s fate stretches into evening
items.description: Nvidia's board is meeting days after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a woman who is believed by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy.

items.title: What we know so far about Nvidia partner Megaspeed’s Asia footprint
items.description: Megaspeed is at the center of a U.S. probe over its role in sending billions of restricted Nvidia chips to China, and its executive's alleged affair with Jensen Huang.

items.title: Elon Musk says it would be an 'honor' to hire Nvidia's Jensen Huang
items.description: The post on X comes amid reports that Nvidia's board is preparing to oust Huang.

items.title: The world's super-rich are piling into alternative investments. Here's why
items.description: Alternative investments now account for 60% of single-family office portfolios, surpassing traditional assets for the first time, according to BNY Wealth.

items.title: Cramer's stance on Nvidia's stock amid reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be ousted
items.description: Jim Cramer said Wednesday night that he was saddened by a news report that indicated Nvidia's board of directors is preparing to fire Huang.

items.title: Jensen Huang affair in D.C.: Resignation calls and moves to tighten Nvidia China exports
items.description: Huang was notably opposed to strict export controls on AI chips to China, which ruffled feathers with congressional China hawks.

items.title: Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate election over incumbent Republican Hyde-Smith
items.description: Scott Colom will be the first Democrat elected to the Senate from the state since 1982, and Mississippi's first Black senator since Reconstruction.

items.description: U.S. officials are accusing two top officials of a Canadian company of operating a scheme to illegally import prescription drugs, court records show.
